name: BMW F650GS (single)
engine: 652 cc liquid-cooled Rotax single, fuel injected, chain drive
intro: A light, simple single-cylinder GS. The water pump seals are the famous weak spot.

add.title: Check the water pump seals
add.instructions: Look for coolant at the weep hole and check the oil for a milky look. If either shows, replace the seals and the pump shaft.
add.reason: The shaft wears a groove at the seals. Milky oil means both seals have failed.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Water pump
known.what: The pump shaft wears a groove at the seals, and frothy oil means stop and fix it.
